contract: Pure version-1 preparation and bounded projection over one conversation resource field. Exact host facts select immutable input messages, input-to-Run associations and completed assistant answers; message IDs are unique within one conversation across all roles and several inputs may share one Run. The checked portable state has exact sorted record/list shapes, at most 64 messages and associations, and at most 65,536 bytes by pinned OTP term_to_binary/1. view/2 requires the host-vouched tenant/actor/resource read scope. No I/O, authentication, authorization, Run creation, persistence or CheckedCommand integration claim.
limits: IDs are 1..128 valid UTF-8 bytes without NUL; message text is 1..4,096 valid UTF-8 bytes and is preserved byte-for-byte, including NUL.
Stored state contains only exact version-1 messages and input/Run associations. Unknown, noncanonical, over-bound or inconsistent state is refused, not repaired or treated as empty.
At most 64 messages and 64 associations; every prospective write can refuse at encoded capacity. No eviction or truncation.
The caller owns CAS, authority, approval, receipts and atomic persistence. A pure proposal is not a committed success.
Mandatory ELZ-252 acceptance of actual Memory/PostgreSQL CheckedCommand composition and RunEngine parity must pass before a durable Conversation or Wave4 completion claim.

grounding.claim: Pinned Cure checks the mode-specific refusal ordering over bounded host-computed duplicate, input, association, completion and answer classifications.

Named finite scenarios cover exact DTOs and portable shapes, round trips, bounded scope, immutable multi-Run progression, malformed references, precedence, every published bound and duplicate-ID/Run-association mutation controls; they are not universal storage or security proofs.
The pinned Cure compiler checks types and totality of the pure conversation mode decision; compiler soundness is not locally proved.
Pinned Elixir maps, binaries and collection operations implement DTO validation and bounded immutable list updates.
The encoded-state limit is byte_size(:erlang.term_to_binary(normalized_portable_state)) under pinned OTP 29.1.2.

The host authenticates facts and read grants, allocates stable Run IDs, attests completed outcomes and commits the returned single-field proposal with its own authority, CAS, receipt, approval and atomicity rules.

telemetry.contract: Pure preparation and projection emit no observations.

config.contract: Exact operands and fixed Contract bounds; no ambient settings.
